put.summary: Replace an instance's content in one go
put.description: Upload every file first (`blobs/check` + `PUT blobs/{sha256}`). The new file list, managed folders and versions replace the current ones in a single transaction and `contentVersion` goes up by one, so players get either the old content or the new one, never a mix. Changed Minecraft or loader versions are checked against the official metadata.

400.description: Invalid request (`validation_error`), paths that clash (`path_conflict`), or versions that don't exist (`invalid_version`).

409.description: Someone applied a change since `expectedContentVersion` (`content_conflict`), or some files aren't uploaded (`missing_blobs`, listed in `detail`). Nothing changed.

502.description: The official metadata couldn't be fetched to check the versions (`metadata_unavailable`).
